ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to new freshmen in the College of Engineering and certain other majors. Students registering for this course must add three CRNs at the same time on the Add/Drop page (not the Class Lookup) to get into the class: 46897 for the lecture, 50015 for the extra credit, and one more for an ED discussion.
